description: Show the busy and slow months for a home-service trade in a US state, a NOAA climate region (Northeast, Upper Midwest, Ohio Valley, Southeast, Northern Rockies and Plains, South, Southwest, Northwest, West) or the whole country. The month-by-month index is measured from BLS QCEW private-sector employment for the trade's NAICS industry, 2022 to 2024. Beside it: NOAA 1991-2020 monthly temperature, degree day and precipitation normals for the same area, and seasonal drivers for the trade (tune-up seasons, freeze months, hurricane season, lawn fertilization windows, termite swarms and others) where a public source supports them. Every claim carries its source.

region.description: Instead of a state, a NOAA climate region: Northeast, Upper Midwest, Ohio Valley, Southeast, Northern Rockies and Plains, South, Southwest, Northwest, West.

state.description: A US state: two-letter code (MT) or full name (Montana).

trade.description: The trade: an id from list_trades (plumbing, hvac, electrical, roofing, landscaping, lawn_care, tree_service, pest_control and more) or a common name such as "plumber" or "AC repair".

name: seasonal_demand
title: Get seasonal demand
